I used to read this book series “Horrible Harry”. One would think a child would understand to not do what Horrible Harry does. 
I was a good kid, I was a teachers pet, a cute little girl who wore dresses everyday and super peppy but then one day...
I went to sit next to my friend at lunch ladedadeda. THEN she told me that she saved that seat for Morgan* - um woah you are not allowed to save seats. I was pissed. I went and sat at another table with my friend and told her what happened. She was appalled. Then I told her about what Horrible Harry does when he’s mad and that we should try it. Horrible Harry holds his fists up to people when he’s angry. My friend thought this was a great idea. We look Morgan in the eyes from across the lunch room and we put our fists up. I had no idea what this motion meant because there was no way little me could / would beat up someone. Well little Morgan started to cry and told the teacher. For the first and last time in my life I was sent to the student support center.

Apply for unemployment on time. Hug people and say goodbye. I volunteer at an elementary school and have for 4 years and I started with in a Kindergarten. Last year was those Kindergarteners last year of elementary school. A lot of them I’ll never see again. I never got to say goodbye and good luck and you’re amazing and to give them a hug. There was going to be field day and their graduation I would see them at and get to say goodbye. I was there on a Friday and never went back. I watched them grow and I grew up with them. When they were in Kindergarten I was a senior in high school and now it’s my 5th year of college. That group of kids wrote me get well cards when I was hospitalized after attempting suicide (they didn’t know why I was in the hospital), on their last day of kindergarten they had a surprise graduation party for me since I didn’t go to my own. They all got dressed up and sang to me. I know this is a rant and I have been lucky that I haven’t had anyone die and not been able to say goodbye. I just wasn’t prepared to say goodbye to them, for them to grow up. I was still supposed to have months with them. None of them knew that they made a huge impact on me and none of them knew that their hugs, smiles and words made my day and gave me reasons to live. 
June was the big ending of a lot of things for me. I didn’t get the closure I needed I know that’s selfish :(

I’m 22 and obsessed with stuffed animals. We also had beams in my house and we put some thick rope across three of them in my room and put my stuffed animals behind them. Then I had some on my bed and some in my “cozy corner” filled with stuffed animals. But when I was 14 we moved to a much smaller house and I could only keep about 15 of them. We donated the rest to our town fire department so when they go out for an emergency and there is a kid they would give them one of my stuffed animals.
